title: Launch Orchestra: Access Guard (RBAC), Audit Pipeline, and KMS Integration for Private/VPC Deployments
creator: Lina Ortega
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch activities for Private/VPC/on-prem feature set that bundles Role-Based Access Controls (fine-grained RBAC), the centralized audit logging pipeline, and KMS/HSM key integration. This ticket centralizes release notes, enablement, and go-to-market tasks to ensure customers and internal teams are ready for GA.
background: This initiative composes three interdependent capabilities required by regulated customers: RBAC for tenant and team isolation, an audit-log pipeline that exports immutable event streams to customer destinations, and KMS integration for customer-managed encryption keys. Engineering has delivered initial GA candidate builds; product needs to finalize rollout sequencing, release notes, and enablement artifacts while aligning legal/security/compliance and support.
objectives: 1) Publish coordinated release notes and KBs that clearly describe behaviour, limitations, and upgrade steps. 2) Drive cross-team readiness (Docs, Console, Support, Sales Engineering, Security) ahead of controlled customer pilots. 3) Define rollout gating criteria and rollback procedures. 4) Ensure telemetry and SLA expectations are documented.
scope: Included: RBAC UI + API, Audit pipeline (log forwarding + retention policy), KMS integration for customer-managed keys, Console toggles for private deployments, release notes, customer onboarding checklist, support runbook, internal enablement session. Excluded: migration tooling for customers using older key formats, custom connectors beyond S3/GCS/Syslog in initial GA.
out_of_scope: Data migration utilities, on-prem installer packaging beyond our supported checklist, enterprise legal contract negotiation (handled by Sales), advanced third-party SIEM connectors for v2.

release_notes_draft:
Headline: Private Deployments — Access Guard (RBAC), Audit Stream, and Customer-Managed Keys
Summary: Customers can now enable fine-grained access controls, export immutable audit logs to their destinations, and provision their own encryption keys for data at rest.
Important notes: KMS onboarding requires an HSM/KMS endpoint and IAM role; RBAC changes are additive and require role provisioning; audit exports will incur storage costs at destination.
Known limitations: Initial connectors: S3, GCS, Syslog. SIEM integrations will be expanded in subsequent releases.
rollout_strategy: 1) Internal beta: Security & Support validate runbooks. 2) Canary: 3 pilot customers on Dedicated or Private deployments (opt-in). 3) Staggered GA: open to new signups with feature flag turned off by default; enable via admin toggle or Sales request. 4) Post-GA: add marketplace listing and standard onboarding flow.
enablement_plan: Deliver 2x 60-minute sessions for Sales Eng and CSMs, publish a recorded training and single-page checklist for onboarding, create step-by-step KBs for self-serve customers, and run a tabletop incident simulation with Support and Security prior to GA.
notes: Risks: KMS edge cases during key rotations, RBAC permissions gaps causing accidental elevated access, audit export failures when destinations have permission changes. Mitigations: preflight checks in onboarding KB, temporary fallback exporter with buffered retry, and explicit RBAC change review step for tenant admins.
